license: MIT (original procedural geometry and flat PBR materials)
reference_game_assets: none; no Re-Volt/RVGL model, texture or data was read
lettering: mesh text from Blender's bundled UI font (no textures)
cultural_references: fictional, kid-safe; docs/research/area51-usaf-nellis-vegas-references.md section A; section B avoided (no DoDEA/USAF/unit marks, no real brands); Month of the Military Child (April, purple) is a generic tradition
interior_lighting: materials carry emission = albedo x 0.5 (warm), ceiling 0.78, troffers 1.0; outdoor-only materials (stucco, rubber, sand, concrete) 0.12-0.15, since the game sun is shadowed indoors
vertex_ao_method: Cycles AO bake to per-corner BYTE_COLOR attribute "AO", exported as COLOR_0; remapped to floor..1. Real bake, no painted shading. Decals, ceilings and the far backdrop are left at 1.0 (not baked).
